newsitem.title: USA: Oncor says breast cancer test moving ahead.
newsitem.headline: Oncor says breast cancer test moving ahead.

text.p: Oncor Inc said Thursday the U.S. Food and Drug Administration is not requiring new clinical trials of its breast cancer test.

Instead, the agency has asked the company to re-run some previously examined specimens at an independent laboratory and to co-develop a custom physician education and training program to help ensure the test can be reproduced in the marketplace.
Those steps must be taken before its Inform Her-2/neu breast cancer test can receive final approval for marketing.
Oncor said the re-running of samples can be done concurrently with the ongoing manufacturing validation and FDA inspection.
The company said there are no assurances that if those steps are taken it will be done in a timely fashion, or that the FDA will grant pre-market approval.
